name: Logic Land
summary:
Who lives where? LogicLand puts a miniature town on the table in front of you, right in your room with passthrough. Every neighbour, pet and car needs a home, and all you have are the clues.

Reach out and pinch a tiny figure to pick it up, or grab it with your controller. Drop Robin the chef next to the Dog, park the taxi in a driveway and watch everyone hop into place. The clue board keeps track: who lives next door, who lives to the left of whom, who shares a house and who never could.
